sections.title: How long is a Bachelor’s in Chemical Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: Most Swiss bachelor programs last three years (six semesters) and are worth 180 ECTS credits. The specific length of time will vary from university to university and depending on the structure of the program.

sections.title: Is it possible for Indian students to study Chemical Engineering in Switzerland after 12th?
sections.lead: Yes, Indian students can apply provided they meet the academic eligibility criteria of the university for their respective country. Some entrants may have to pass further examinations or additional qualifications.

sections.title: Do I need IELTS for Chemical Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: Not always. Many bachelor’s programs are taught mainly in German or French, so knowledge of the relevant language may be required instead Check out your preferred programme's language policy.

sections.title: Are there any Chemical Engineering bachelor’s programs taught in English in Switzerland?
sections.lead: Not many options are taught fully in English. Some courses are taught in English, but not necessarily the entire bachelor's degree.

sections.title: What can I do with a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering in Switzerland?
sections.lead: You can work in pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, process design, biotechnology, materials production, and quality control. You can also apply for a relevant master’s degree, subject to admission requirements.
